text:
elaine: Heads up team - HelixPay wants a 4-week POC starting Mon. Must-haves: SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM for ~85k users (initial bulk + delta), RBAC via groups + SAML attribute fallback, and domain proof for 2 primary domains + one delegated payments subdomain. They also asked for a short Dedicated window vs hosted pricing comparison. Can @cory @marcus triage infra/security blockers?

cory: Quick clarifying Qs: are the delegated subdomains under customer control or managed by partners? That affects TXT proofing and cert issuance. Also need peak auth TPS to size Dedicated.

elaine: HelixPay owns the two primaries, partner manages payments. Peak auth ~800 rps during batch settlement windows; baseline ~150 rps.

marcus: Security note - they require signed assertions and want encrypted assertions for account linking. NameID should be persistent (not email) for SSO binding to internal account IDs. They also want SAML attribute "memberOf" used if SCIM groups lag.

elaine: They prefer persistent NameID. They can send memberOf claims but will also provision groups via SCIM.

cory: SCIM concerns: initial bulk of 85k will need pagination + staged imports. We should ask them to split initial creates into 5k chunks or use our bulk import endpoint. Recommend delta polling with If-Modified-Since or incremental change token. Example delta header we accept: 
```
GET /scim/v2/Users?startIndex=1&count=200&filter=meta.lastModified gt 2026-02-15T00:00:00Z
Authorization: Bearer <poctoken>
```
Also confirm whether they will PATCH group membership or full replace groups on update. PATCH is preferred.

marcus: For RBAC mapping we usually do SCIM group -> platform role mapping, but we can accept SAML attribute fallback for session-time assignments. Suggest storing authoritative mapping in config file for audit. Sample mapping csv we ask for: 
```
scim_group,platform_role,env
ops,admin,prod
payments,operator,prod
support,viewer,prod
```
This avoids ambiguity.

elaine: Domain proofing method question: do we support DNS TXT for partner-managed subdomain? If partner can't update DNS, they want to route via CNAME to our verification service.

cory: We support DNS TXT and CNAME verification; for delegated subdomains CNAME is fine but requires partner coordination. Note: TTL <3600 recommended during prove. If they want custom certs we need CSR + SAN list.

marcus: Security questionnaire items: assertion signing algorithm (RSA-SHA256), accepted clock skew (<=120s), SCIM auth flow (OAuth2 client credentials with rotation), audit log retention (90 days standard, extended by request). I can draft SQA answers.

elaine: Also they asked about IP allowlisting and VPC peering for Dedicated. HelixPay needs egress restriction to their payment processors.

cory: For Dedicated we can do VPC peering + IP allowlist + customer-managed KMS for secrets. Hosted can support IP allowlist but not customer HSM. Need to flag that KMS/HSM pushes them to Private or VPC model.

finance-bot: Pricing prompt: estimate ready? Need expected MAU to compare hosted vs short-term Dedicated.

elaine: MAU ~2.1M monthly; most calls are auth/token and occasional heavy settle time.

cory: With those numbers, Dedicated for 3 months looks reasonable if they want predictable latency; hosted + burst better for flexible budget. I'll draft capacity numbers.

marcus: Operational ask: send us a tiny CSV of 50 sample users + example group mappings and generate SAML metadata so we can run an end-to-end dry run in our staging. Also please provide SCIM test credentials with limited scope.

ops-bot: Created ticket #RDW-4899 (owner: cory) - checklist: SAML metadata, SCIM staging creds, 50-sample CSV, group mapping CSV, domain TXT/CNAME proof, MAU/peak RPS, KMS requirement, desired retention SLA.

elaine: OK I'll coordinate a 30min call Thurs 2pm PT with HelixPay infra + security to hand over artifacts. Cory/marcus please prep notes on SCIM throttling/backoff guidance and a 1-pager on mapping approaches.

cory: Will prepare backoff guidance (exponential backoff, 429 handling, Retry-After). Example: on 429 wait 2^n * 100ms up to 5s, then escalate.

marcus: I'll draft SAML compliance checklist + SQA responses and post before Wed EOD.

elaine: Awesome. Thanks team :handshake:
